2609.09778.title: ROAM: Robust Organization of Atomic Memories for Agents through Semantic Relations
2609.09778.paper_summary: Long-term language-model agents rely on external memory across interactions. Atomic memories are particularly useful: their fine-grained semantic boundaries enable precise retrieval and direct comparison between observations. Yet accumulating atoms inevitably become redundant, overlapping, or conflicting. Existing methods often ask an LLM manager to add, update, delete, or rewrite memories directly, coupling semantic interpretation, storage decisions, and content generation in one error-prone operation. We introduce ROAM, a relation-guided framework that uses atomicity for management while allowing richer answer-time representations. ROAM classifies incoming--stored atom pairs as independent, equivalent, directionally subsuming, or conflicting, then organizes observations into active Primary and supporting Evidence roles. Fusion subsequently combines complementary details and temporal changes into compact, potentially non-atomic views. Only Primary views are retrieved for answering, preventing redundant or outdated atoms from competing independently. Across models and evaluation settings, ROAM improves answer accuracy by up to 29.8 percentage points. Ablations show complementary benefits from different relations and consistent gains from fusion beyond role organization. Mechanism analysis further finds 15.6-point higher answer-critical source recall and an 11.5-point lower confounder-token share. ROAM remains robust across manager scales.
2609.09778.paper_summary_zh: 長期的語言模型代理依賴於跨互動的外部記憶。原子記憶尤其有用：其細緻的語義邊界使得精確檢索和直接比較觀察成為可能。然而，累積的原子不可避免地會變得冗餘、重疊或衝突。現有的方法通常要求LLM管理者直接添加、更新、刪除或重寫記憶，將語義解釋、存儲決策和內容生成結合在一起，這是一個容易出錯的操作。我們介紹了ROAM，一種關係引導的框架，利用原子性進行管理，同時允許更豐富的回答時間表示。ROAM將進來的存儲原子對分類為獨立、等價、方向性包含或衝突，然後將觀察組織成主動的主要和支持證據角色。融合隨後將互補的細節和時間變化結合成緊湊的、潛在的非原子視圖。只有主要視圖會被檢索以進行回答，防止冗餘或過時的原子獨立競爭。在各種模型和評估設置中，ROAM將回答準確性提高了多達29.8個百分點。消融實驗顯示不同關係帶來互補的好處，並且融合在角色組織之外持續帶來增益。機制分析進一步發現回答關鍵來源的回憶率提高了15.6點，而混淆標記的份額降低了11.5點。ROAM在管理者規模上保持穩健。
